_comment: Non-secret operational config for sgv-tweet-digest. Copy this file to your real config (e.g. ~/.config/sgv-tweet-digest/config.json) and fill in YOUR values. Secrets do NOT belong here; they live in your .env (see .env.example). Your real config copy is gitignored.
_accounts_comment: The two X accounts you draft for. personal = the 'mist' voice (your handle); sgv = the 'sgv' fund voice. Resolve numeric user ids at e.g. https://tweeterid.com or via the X API users/by/username endpoint.
_followed_list_ids_comment: X Lists whose tweets Stage A gathers (read via OAuth2 user token against YOUR @handle). Each entry: numeric list id + a human label + the list owner's handle. Replace these examples with the Lists you actually follow. A List id is the number in https://x.com/i/lists/<id>.
_membership_allowlist_comment: Optional name-substring allowlist used when snapshotting which Lists you belong to. Leave empty [] to include all, or list label fragments to keep only matching Lists.
_models_comment: Anthropic model ids the pipeline calls. Opus does the high-stakes scoring + draft selection; Sonnet does the insights pass, good-content drafting, idea matching, and feedback profile. Override here if you want different model versions; the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY itself lives in .env.
_budget_comment: Cost guardrail: the hard ceiling gather_x.py enforces on paid X API spend per day (calls that would push past it are skipped, config-order).
_scoring_comment: Heuristic scoring knobs (digest.py). candidate_count = how many top-scoring candidates to hand to Opus for the final pick. score_threshold = optional minimum 0-18 heuristic score for the candidate pool (softly enforced: skipped for the run if it would leave fewer than top_n tweets; set 0 to disable).
